EditBox.summary: Text edit box base class: cursor, selection, copy/paste, IME input and inline text coloring

props.padding: Inner padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, default {3,3,3,3}
props.hintFont: Font property table used for the hint text; defaults to Control.font with color overridden to {1,1,1,0.7}
props.text: Plain text content (the source says not to use it directly); read/write it through SetText/GetText, the layout lives in lines/physicalLines
props.hint: Hint text shown when there is no text and the box is not focused, default ""
props.cursor: Logical cursor position (1-based UTF-8 byte index), default 1
props.offset: Horizontal scroll offset (index of the first visible character), default 1
props.lineSpacing: Extra line spacing in pixels, added to lineHeight, default 0
props.selStart: Selection start (logical character position), nil when nothing is selected
props.selEnd: Selection end (logical character position), nil when nothing is selected
props.selectable: Allow selecting and hit-testing, default true; HitTest returns false when it is false
props.multiline: Multi-line mode, default false; when true, logical lines are distinguished from physical (wrapped) lines
props.subTooltips: Enable per-span tooltips (MouseMove looks up line.tooltips at the cursor), default false
props.useIME: Enable IME text input, default true (source note: currently broken, so every text box enables it)
props.passwordInput: Password mode (characters shown as '*', cursor hit-testing uses an equal-length mask), default false
props.lines: Array of logical lines, each {text, tooltips, OnTextClick, pls}; pls holds the matching physical line indices
props.cursorX: Logical column of the cursor, default 1
props.cursorY: Logical line number of the cursor, default 1
props.inedibleInput: Set of key codes (keys from Spring.GetKeyCode) that the edit box will not swallow, e.g. enter, esc, F1-F12
props.noFont: Skip automatic creation of the default font and hintFont, default false

EditBox:New.desc: Construct an EditBox: create hintFont if needed, initialize the text and physical lines via SetText, then RequestUpdate

params.obj: Property table that overrides the defaults

EditBox:Dispose.desc: Clear hintFont's parent (when noHint is false) and run Control.Dispose for cleanup

EditBox:HitTest.desc: Hit test: returns self when selectable is true, otherwise false

EditBox:SetText.desc: Set the whole text: reset cursor/selection/line caches, split on newlines, AddLine each piece, then UpdateLayout and Invalidate

EditBox:_LineLog2Phys.desc: Convert a position inside a logical line into physical-line coordinates (px, py); passes through when not multiline (internal)

EditBox:_SetSelection.desc: Set the selection and convert it to physical coordinates (selStartPhysical/selEndPhysical); fields passed as nil keep their old value (internal)

EditBox:GetPhysicalLinePosition.desc: Return the y of the physical line that starts the logical line distanceFromBottom lines from the bottom, or 0 when out of range

params.distanceFromBottom: Number of logical lines from the bottom

EditBox:_GeneratePhysicalLines.desc: Wrap the given logical line with font:WrapText, parse \255 color prefixes, accumulate y and Resize when autoHeight is set (internal)

EditBox:AddLine.desc: Append a logical line (long text wraps automatically), store tooltips/OnTextClick, then RequestUpdate and Invalidate

EditBox:GetText.desc: Return the current text: the raw text when not multiline, otherwise the logical lines joined with newlines

EditBox:UpdateLayout.desc: Rebuild all physical lines and re-resolve the selection; when autoHeight or autosize is set, recompute the size and Resize the control

EditBox:Update.desc: Per-frame update: call the inherited Update; while focused and editable keep calling RequestUpdate and Invalidate every 0.1 s to blink the cursor

EditBox:FocusUpdate.desc: Start/stop SDL text input on focus change (SDLStartTextInput/SDLStopTextInput) and set the candidate rect, then run the inherited FocusUpdate

EditBox:_GetCursorByMousePos.desc: Compute the cursor position from the mouse position and the physical lines without changing any state (internal)

EditBox:_SetCursorByMousePos.desc: Call _GetCursorByMousePos and write the result back to offset/cursor/cursorY and friends (internal)

EditBox:MouseDown.desc: Click handling: fire span OnTextClick callbacks when hit, otherwise extend the selection with shift or clear it and move the cursor, then Invalidate

EditBox:MouseMove.desc: Move handling: set the span tooltip under the cursor when subTooltips is on; extend the selection and Invalidate while dragging with the left button

EditBox:MouseUp.desc: Call the inherited MouseUp, Invalidate and return self

EditBox:Select.desc: Select the range startIndex to endIndex on line 1 and Invalidate

EditBox:ClearSelected.desc: Delete the selected text character by character with Utf8BackspaceAt, clear the selection markers and Invalidate

EditBox:UpdateLine.desc: Replace the text of one logical line and rebuild all physical lines; falls back to AddLine when the line is missing and lineID is 1 (source note: only tested without multiline)

EditBox:GetSelectionText.desc: Return the selected plain text (strips \255 color prefixes and \b), or nil when there is no selection

EditBox:KeyPress.desc: Handle keys: backspace/delete, arrows and Home/End, Ctrl+C/X/V/A clipboard and select-all, shift selection extension; returns whether the input was swallowed

EditBox:TextInput.desc: Insert the typed character at the cursor (deleting the selection first), update text and cursor, UpdateLayout + Invalidate; returns false when not editable

EditBox:TextEditing.desc: IME pre-edit handling: store the composing text in textEditing; returns false when not editable

fileDesc: Defines the EditBox class: the full text editing control, including logical/physical line layout, cursor and selection, mouse/keyboard handling, clipboard and IME input.
